deployment.library_source: clean pinned library copied from isolated completed deployment; local dirty library excluded
clean pinned library copied from isolated completed deployment; local dirty library excluded

protocol.scientific_goal: learn the low-to-high-beta distributional transition and test parameter sharing; accurate thermodynamic-response recovery is not a primary claim

scope.generators: all one- and two-body X-string IQP phases
scope.projected_encoder: replaced by parity; no fifth study

training.loss: fixed sampled squared-MMD; no added TVD or physics terms; kernel settings fixed within a fit
training.anchor_allocation: independent uniform draw per update, probability 1/4 per shared anchor

target_pool_policy.across_repeats: independent pools with accepted stage-specific repeat counts and structured seed manifest

kernel.bandwidth_mapping: sigma=[-2*log(1-2*w/n)]^(-1/2), before identity-mask exclusion; explicit finite w=7.99 at n=16
kernel.representation: single categorical over 45 unique ordered pairs; uniform random prior; completed pilot choice retained; no pilot rerun

encoder.scale_sharing: one scalar per conditional candidate; joint across independent parity cases
encoder.product: RZ(s*beta) RY(pi/2)|0> on every physical wire; RY fixed
encoder.parity: RX(s*beta) on wires 0..14; CNOT from each leaf to wire 15; Hadamard on all 16 wires
encoder.parity_reference: 15 independent Bernoulli bits with probability sin(s*beta/2)^2, root XOR; no ancillas
encoder.parity_guarantee: global spin-flip invariance preserved by X-generated IQP; not full permutation invariance

training.numerics: preserve manuscript precision and public-library contraction conventions; record actual environment and implementation tolerances before launch

primary.average_domain: actual stage evaluation span; no padding to unevaluated endpoints
primary.single_temperature: max and average both equal point value
primary.repeat_aggregation: compute metrics per selected fit/case before arithmetic averaging; never score averaged probabilities

physics.normalization_fixed: same target-only value across families and stages
physics.interpretation: learned c_fluc is an energy-fluctuation statistic, not a verified thermal derivative

eligibility.anchor: minimum primary score over the same selection-stage candidate pool
eligibility.winner: minimum physics score inside primary eligibility set
eligibility.not: statistical equivalence or hard absolute-accuracy requirement

objectives.sampler_feedback: primary J only; P and component curves retained as metadata; no extra scalar physics weight or multiobjective sampler

fit_selection.procedure: per circuit/repeat pool all scheduled checkpoints from all available starts; find pool minimum J; choose minimum P within J<=pool_min+0.01; apply tolerance once over full pool
fit_selection.shared_temperatures: A only in every stage; B never chooses checkpoints/starts
fit_selection.independent_temperatures: direct-fit reporting case only; single-temperature score convention
fit_selection.ties: physics score, then primary score, then earliest checkpoint step, then lowest start index
fit_selection.retention: retain recoverable parameters and J/P/components for all checkpoints, plus selected/end states; no mixture of fitted states

independent_families.configuration: one jointly selected hyperparameter configuration per family; independent learned phases per case; shared scale for parity
independent_families.primary_and_physics: aggregate cases across actual reporting temperatures within each repeat using accepted R, then average repeat scores
independent_families.resource_difference: 3 circuits/408 phases/3 times updates; 3072 target-pool entries versus 4096 for a shared repeat
independent_families.evaluation: report at directly fitted cases; no independent continuous response or whole-grid accuracy claim

search.trial_counts: proposals including numerical failures; same-identity infrastructure retry does not add a proposal

random_phase.distribution: independent draws from frozen priors; 45 kernel pairs uniform; schedule choices equally probable; no forced balance or adaptive draw
random_phase.scheduling: parallel trials/studies permitted within validated GPU capacity; freeze configurations/IDs/seeds before scheduling
random_phase.pause: every study stops after 60; review before TPE; no automatic confirmation/final fitting
random_phase.review: A/direct-case scores and curves, MMD trajectories, kernel/schedule choices, coverage/failures; no shared B/F model inspection
random_phase.forced_reference_checks: not part of 60 independent draws; no extra fitting checks included in nominal campaign

tpe_phase.resume: same study includes all 60 random outcomes; no empty-study restart
tpe_phase.proposal_order: sequential within study, concurrent studies permitted

sampler.other_controls: retain pinned defaults; 60 independently sampled random observations precede adaptive TPE; no extra warm-start/queued study proposals
sampler.rationale: one frozen categorical/numeric search space per family; sequential adaptive proposals; inherited multivariate TPE
sampler.limitation: these settings freeze an algorithm, not an empirically proven optimal sampler; backend concurrency remains a separate feasibility check

search.protocol_revision_at_review: any changed settings get a named new protocol with disclosed development history; no silently mixed incomparable scores

confirmation.source: all 120 screening proposals in each study
confirmation.shortlist: best J; best P within J_min+0.01; fill to three distinct configurations by J; add global best P if not already selected
confirmation.ties: J ranking: (J,P,trial_id); P ranking: (P,J,trial_id); exact duplicate configurations count once
confirmation.shared_rank_temperatures: A union B, 37 points; fitted checkpoints still selected on A only
confirmation.winner: recompute confirmed J/P and minimum J among valid confirmed candidates, then minimize P among J<=confirmed_min+0.01
confirmation.global_physics_candidate: same confirmed eligibility guardrail; otherwise tradeoff diagnostic
confirmation.feedback_to_tpe: none; no further proposals after B inspection

final_fitting.shared_selection: accepted checkpoint/start rule on A only
final_fitting.independent_selection: accepted rule on directly fitted beta only
final_fitting.repeat_retention: all ten selected repeat outcomes; no best-repeat selection
final_fitting.checkpoints_apply_to: all stages; initialization and final included; full budget, no performance early stopping

randomness.campaign_namespace: cw-parity-hpo-followup-20261009 included in every stream; prevents reuse of completed campaign pools/starts
randomness.derivation: stable SHA-256-derived seeds from canonical structured stream keys; record full keys/digests, actual backend seed widths, intentional pairing groups and collision checks
randomness.target_pool_key: campaign,stage,repeat,exact_training_beta,purpose; omit family/candidate/restart to pair compatible pools
randomness.fit_stream_key: campaign,stage,repeat,case,restart,purpose; case shared or exact independent beta; compatible families paired; omit candidate to preserve paired proposal comparisons
randomness.case_pairing: shared product/parity share compatible streams; independent parity/unconditional share case streams; initialization standard normals scaled by candidate width
randomness.stage_separation: screen versus confirmation versus final independent target pools/fit streams; random and TPE use the same screen repeat identities
randomness.reference_note: same reference seed does not imply same model-dependent samples
randomness.preflight_requirement: record complete manifest and collision/intentional pairing checks; one sampler seed per study

failures.screening: 120 proposed configurations per study in two phases; numerical failures count in their phase; primary penalty 1 with flag, not measured TVD; invalid candidates ineligible for shortlist; physics failures flag candidate invalid
failures.numerical_scope: nonfinite parameters, gradient, probabilities or metric, or invalid probability normalization beyond declared numerical tolerance; numerical tolerances must be recorded before campaign launch
failures.remaining_repeats: complete eligible screening repeats using their fixed identities; never replace a failed repeat with another seed; irrecoverably invalid configuration may terminate remaining fits and penalize remaining repeats, with reason retained
failures.shortlist: require at least three distinct valid screening configurations; confirm original three plus global physics candidate if new; otherwise halt for diagnosis without adding proposals
failures.confirmation: any numerically failed confirmation candidate is ineligible; choose among remaining eligible confirmed candidates; halt if none
failures.final: an unresolved final numerical failure halts evaluation for diagnosis; no replacement seed, favorable-repeat selection or silent denominator change
failures.infrastructure: one automatic replay/resume of the same immutable job after an infrastructure interruption; second interruption pauses execution for diagnosis without consuming a new proposal or assigning a numerical penalty
failures.identity: new campaign namespace plus matching config/source/library/environment/seed identities; durable proposal IDs and phase counters; resolve pending jobs before new proposals; random parallel completion order must not alter configuration draws
failures.limitation: failure penalties are search conventions, not observed errors; failures may reduce the eligible search set and must be disclosed

reporting.aggregate: per-fit metrics before mean and sample SD ddof=1; retain all repeats; SD is not a confidence interval
reporting.main_comparison: shared parity, independent parity and independent unconditional at common markers; shared parity full sweep; no product curves in main comparison
reporting.appendix: matched shared product/parity ablation; physics diagnostics retained regardless of outcomes; disclose physics-based selection
reporting.shared_full_grid: unchanged 101-point F grid; report raw worst TVD, normalized TVD integral and combined J; extra evaluations at common markers do not select fits
reporting.independent: marker errors and matched marker aggregate only; no independent whole-grid integral/max claim
reporting.profiles: signed magnetization distributions illustrate transition; full bitstring TVD guards against within-shell errors
reporting.physics: mean absolute magnetization, c_fluc, component errors and P; signed mean/flip defect diagnostic only
reporting.range_labels: shared interpolation [0.1,1.95]; small edge extrapolation outside; marker locations excluded from shared A/B but range previously explored
reporting.resource_disclosure: equal HPO proposal/per-circuit budgets do not imply equal aggregate parameters, target draws or updates
reporting.claims: no guaranteed parity superiority, continuum fidelity, thermodynamic-response recovery or practical quantum advantage; report finite-search outcomes under this protocol

nominal_resource_accounting.assumptions: 3 or 4 distinct valid confirmation candidates per study, all runs succeed; excludes backend correctness/benchmark checks and identical infrastructure retries; no representation pilot or extra recovery fits
nominal_resource_accounting.eta: not established for parity/full objective/concurrency; benchmark before launch

implementation_before_execution: paper-side public API encoder/metric/selection adapters; no library changes
separate protocol loader, hashes and seed/collision manifest
durable independent-random phase, cross-study review barrier and explicit TPE continuation
checkpoint parameter retention and objective/tolerance selection correctness
parity probability, reference sampling/amplitude ratios and gradients versus exact small cases
CPU/GPU numerical compatibility and bounded throughput/memory benchmark in existing GPU container
meaningful smoke, resume/retry and stage-boundary tests
record config/source/library/environment/pools/seeds and metrics for each fit
